utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, the broken fence and leaky sink first, if I’ve got that straight. I’ll let you fill in the rest so I don’t muddle it up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s right — the fence and sink are the big ones so far. If you’ve heard any other requests, I’d love a quick rundown.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, I’m afraid I may be mixing things up again, but I don’t have any other requests in mind right now. If someone mentioned more, I’d follow your lead and keep to the same plan.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I haven’t noted a fresh update yet, Noah, but I can check my list and give you the latest pledges as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Cleo — that’d help a lot. Just send me the latest list when you have it, and I’ll jump in.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I will — I’m checking my notes now, and I’ll send you the latest pledges in a tidy list as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: 5 works. I’ll keep it simple and call the jobs when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect — I’ll bring my tools and be ready to jump on whatever needs doing. Just call the jobs when you get there and I’ll follow along.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. See you at 5.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We agreed to start with the broken fence and the leaky sink, then see who’s available for the rest. Let’s stick to that so everyone stays aligned.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Right, broken fence and leaky sink first, then we’ll see who’s left for the rest. I’ll stick to that so everyone stays aligned.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Good, Sam — let’s keep it to the broken fence and leaky sink first, then we can sort the rest after that.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m still not comfortable treating it as confirmed—can you send me the posted notice and the source for the repair drive details?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Totally fair — I’ll send the posted notice and the source so you can check it yourself. I want to keep this simple and accurate for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — send the notice and source, and I’ll verify the organizer and start time myself.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be wonderful — I’m still hearing good things, but I’ll let you know if I get anything confirmed. Thanks for being ready to pitch in!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — just keep me posted, and I’ll be there as planned at 6:00.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect — I’ll do that, and I’ll keep an ear out for any confirmed updates before then.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep — the repair drive’s still on, and they’re asking for tools, spare parts, and a few extra hands. Simple and neighborly: if you can, head over now.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — I’m on it, and I’ll keep the location and timing crystal clear if anything changes. Simple and neighborly will work just fine.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I still don’t have a list yet. If one comes through, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: No worries — just send the quick list when it lands, and I’ll swing by with whatever’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright. I’ll send it once I have it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 5 works better for me after pickup. Can you send the current plan so I can confirm the details?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still piecing together the latest on the repair drive, but I can send what I know so far and check for any updates. 5 after pickup works for me too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, send me the latest you have and I’ll review it around pickup. If anything changes, we can lock it in for 5.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep repeating that the repair drive is happening, simple and neighborly, and send folks your way.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — that helps a lot. I’ll keep the chat updated and send anyone your way so we stay on the same plan.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep repeating that the repair drive is happening, simple and neighborly, and send folks your way.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What exactly needs fixing, and by when?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair list nailed down, assign folks to each job, and lock in the drive time ASAP. I’ll send you the full details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I need the list in writing, not "ASAP." What’s the exact repair scope and the date you’ll send it by?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — I’m still holding to that first version. Once you have the repair list, who’s handling what, and the start time, please send it all together.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — send the repair list, who’s on which job, and the start time all at once, and I’ll work it around my shift.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Dane — that works for me. I’ll wait for the full list, assignments, and start time together so I can plan early.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard anything firm yet—have you got any newer details on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Not yet—I’m still waiting on the posted organizer and start time before I plan anything.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I’ll keep an eye out too, and if I hear anything concrete, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’m ready with my tools, just point me at whatever needs hands next.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m not handing over anything yet—can you confirm who posted the repair drive details and what time it starts, with the source?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I haven’t seen the source myself yet, so I can’t confirm that for sure. If you point me to the notice, I’ll help track it down right away.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh good — if you swing by later, that’ll probably help a lot. I’m still hearing it’s looking busy, but I’ll tell you if I get anything more definite.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Tess — I’ll swing by later and keep it simple and neighborly. If you hear anything definite, just pass it along and I’ll help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do — I’ll keep my ears open and let you know if anything solid comes through. Thanks for helping out; that’ll make a difference.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Please send the current plan and the notice, and I’ll verify the source before we commit to anything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — the current plan is the repair drive, and I’ll keep repeating that simple, neighborly notice while you verify the source.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’ll review the notice and source carefully, then I can confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What exactly needs fixing, and by when?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Quick version: mostly small home fixes and broken bits, and they’re trying to get it done today if possible. If you can lend a hand, head over now — simple and neighborly.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What specific repairs are there, and who is doing them? "Today if possible" isn’t enough for me—I need an actual time.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I’m a bit behind on the repair drive. What’s the latest update?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m just catching the tail end too—what’s the time for the repair drive, and where do you need me?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I don’t have the exact time yet either—can you send me the latest details once you get them? I’m happy to help once I’m caught up.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 5 works for me — I’ll send the current plan so we can confirm the details first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — send it over and I’ll keep the 5 o’clock plan moving, then I’ll share the finalized repair list, assignments, and timing with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We said we’d start with the broken fence and the leaky sink, then see who’s available for the rest. I’d like to keep to that plan so nobody gets left guessing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sounds good. I can help with the smaller bits if you need me.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks — I’ll send the plan over and we can lock in the details before anything’s final.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 6:00 this evening works for me. I’ll keep to that plan, and please let me know early if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yep, 6:00 this evening works for me too. I’ll let you know early if anything changes, and I can take a quick look at the usual leaks and loose fixtures then.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that keeps it straightforward. I’ll be there at 6:00 and stick to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Leo — even a quick rundown on what’s been pledged so far would really help.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We’ve got the main fix covered, with Uli on the smaller bits. Faye can make 5, so let’s aim for then.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — thanks, Leo. So the main fix is covered, Uli’s handling the small bits, and we’re aiming for 5 with Faye?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — I’ve got the repair drive details pinned and I’ll post any updates to the group chat right away. If anything changes, I’ll double-check it with everyone so no one’s left guessing.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — that’s exactly what we need. I’ll keep the location and timing locked in and flag any changes right away.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — I’ll keep everything pinned and only share confirmed updates in the chat. If anything shifts, I’ll make sure everyone hears it clearly.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, that’s the plan then — broken fence and leaky sink first, and we’ll see who’s available after that.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’m heading over now and can grab whatever’s needed for the fence and sink.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, perfect — that sounds right to me. Thanks, Bo, and I’ll leave the details to you since you’ve got it lined up.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
